run_rgb_stacking_viewer: run the rgb stacking environment viewer with a specified object triplet
render_policy_to_video: render a trained policy running in the rgb stacking environment and save as mp4 video
run_episode_and_render: run a policy episode against the rgb stacking environment and return rendered image frames
load_policy_from_path: load a trained mpo policy from a saved model file path for the rgb stacking task
launch_dm_control_viewer: launch the dm_control interactive viewer with the rgb stacking environment and optional policy
